title: Fit spin-orbit coupling strength μ
action: Perform trial self-consistent plane-wave DFT calculations for zinc-blende InSb with a variable spin-orbit coupling strength μ (using the Chelikowsky-Cohen scheme) and adjust μ so that the spin-orbit splitting between the two topmost valence bands at Γ matches exactly 0.81 eV. Save the final μ value.

title: Self-consistent DFT for zinc-blende InSb
action: Run a self-consistent plane-wave pseudopotential DFT calculation for zinc-blende InSb (lattice constant 6.47 Å) using the Starkloff–Joannopoulos local pseudopotential parameters for In and Sb, Slater Xα exchange-correlation (α=1), the fitted spin-orbit coupling strength μ, and mass-velocity/Darwin corrections with provided matrix elements. Save the converged valence charge density and the band energies along a high-symmetry path.

title: Self-consistent DFT for rocksalt InSb
action: Run the same self-consistent pseudopotential DFT procedure for rocksalt InSb (lattice constant 6.12 Å) with the same pseudopotential and corrections, adjusting the spin-orbit coupling strength μ linearly with unit-cell volume relative to the zinc-blende cell. Save the converged valence charge density and the band energies.

title: Extract scored quantities
action: From the zinc-blende band energies determine the fundamental band gap and valence bandwidth. From the zinc-blende and rocksalt charge densities compute the charge transfer from In to Sb by partitioning valence charge using touching spheres of equal radii centered on In and Sb atoms. Write the four numbers to /app/outputs/results.json.
description: Final scored artifact containing the four required numeric quantities: zinc-blende band gap, zinc-blende valence bandwidth, zinc-blende charge transfer, and rocksalt charge transfer.
